name: recruitee
description: Lets the Flux interviews app read vacancies, candidates and booked interviews from Recruitee. It never changes anything in Recruitee.
long_description: Paste a personal API token from Recruitee (Settings, Apps and plugins, Personal API tokens) and your company ID. The token stays on this computer. Without a token the extension returns mock data, so the app can be tried first.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Whether the extension is connected to Recruitee or returning mock data.

tools.name: list_candidates
tools.description: Candidates on one vacancy with their current stage.

tools.name: list_interviews
tools.description: Interviews booked in Recruitee's agenda in a date range.

tools.name: get
tools.description: Read any Recruitee API path (GET only), for checking the data.

api_token.title: Recruitee personal API token
api_token.description: Recruitee: Settings > Apps and plugins > Personal API tokens. Leave empty to use mock data.

company_id.title: Recruitee company ID
company_id.description: Shown on the Personal API tokens page.
